ideas.description: Quarter of OBV accumulation with flat price, entered on a fresh 50-day cross above a rising 200-day; exit on OBV distribution or 50-day break.

what_it_does.buy: close crosses above sma(50) and obv_trend(63) is above 0.1 and roc(63) is below 0.05 and close is above sma(200)
what_it_does.sell: obv_trend(21) is below -0.05 or close is below 0.93 × sma(50)
what_it_does.order: buys the most heavily traded names first
what_it_does.size: up to 10 stocks at 10% of the account each

indicators.label: obv_trend(63)
indicators.about: On-balance volume over length bars as a share of all volume: +1 = every bar up, -1 = every bar down.

indicators.label: obv_trend(21)
indicators.about: On-balance volume over length bars as a share of all volume: +1 = every bar up, -1 = every bar down.

indicators.label: roc(63)
indicators.about: Rate of change of close over length bars (0.05 = +5%).

notes: NEW (Granville, OBV leads price): OBV63 > 0.1 while roc63 < 5%, fresh close above the 50-day, above the 200-day; exit OBV21 < -0.05 or 7% under the 50-day. Accumulation without price movement doesn't lead; flat-price names stay flat and the OBV21 exit churns.
